the assertion consumer service.

303.description: Assertion consumer service: the identity provider posts a form-encoded SAMLResponse here. On success sets the session cookie and redirects (303) to the app root (/); otherwise to /login?error=sso_failed. Browser redirect with a Location header. Failures never show a reason to the browser: they redirect to the login page with ?error=sso_failed (or sso_unavailable when single sign-on is not set up).

get.summary: what the administrator gives the IdP (public information).

200.description: SAML 2.0 service provider metadata (entity id, assertion consumer URL) to give the identity provider. Public.

get.summary: redirects the browser to the identity provider with an AuthnRequest.

302.description: Redirects to the identity provider with an AuthnRequest (sets the signed lms_saml flow cookie). Browser redirect with a Location header. Failures never show a reason to the browser: they redirect to the login page with ?error=sso_failed (or sso_unavailable when single sign-on is not set up).

get.summary: GET /api/v1/auth/sso/callback

302.description: Where the identity provider sends the browser back. On success sets the session cookie and redirects to the app root (/); otherwise to /login?error=sso_failed. Browser redirect with a Location header. Failures never show a reason to the browser: they redirect to the login page with ?error=sso_failed (or sso_unavailable when single sign-on is not set up).

get.summary: redirects to the identity provider.

302.description: Redirects to the identity provider's authorization endpoint (PKCE, state and nonce; sets the signed lms_sso flow cookie). Browser redirect with a Location header. Failures never show a reason to the browser: they redirect to the login page with ?error=sso_failed (or sso_unavailable when single sign-on is not set up).
